## Complete compatibility release train

AgentWorks BOM 1.17.0 assembles the complete certified train: Agent Workflow 0.12.0, Agent Hooks
0.8.0, Agent Memory 0.5.0, Agent Experiment 0.7.0, ACP Java SDK 0.16.0, Agent Client 0.29.0, and
Agent Journal 1.8.0. All managed modules in those families move together to their released lines.

Workflow 0.12.0 carries the Agent Judge 0.15 compatibility migration, preserves inconclusive
judge evidence through gate recovery, and exports its Jackson and NetworkNT security floors to
standalone consumers. Client 0.29.0 and Journal 1.8.0 are the released compatibility baseline
verified by the PR-review polyglot experiment. Hooks, Memory, Experiment, and ACP carry their
current compatibility, consumer-graph, and dependency-security baselines from the same release
train.

The BOM now also manages `com.networknt:json-schema-validator` at 3.0.7. NetworkNT requires
Jackson 3.2.1, so the BOM selects that compatible line while remaining above the required 3.1.6
security floor. Jackson 2 core/databind remain at 2.21.6; the independently versioned annotations
artifact moves to 2.22 as required by Jackson 3.2.1. Workflow's direct published declarations
continue to protect consumers that do not import the BOM.
